last_review_suggestions: Consider adding a type guard for StorageFile validation instead of relying on a generic check for Array.isArray(parsed.notes)

The criterion says ~/.notes/notes.lock but the implementation uses ~/.notes/notes.json.lock. This is a minor discrepancy — the criterion text may need clarification.
Consider adding unit tests for isPathSafe with edge cases (e.g., symlinks, trailing slashes, empty string) to ensure robustness.
Consider using program.exitOverride() with a custom handler instead of calling process.exit() directly in action handlers to allow Commander to manage exit codes uniformly
The run function accepts service as a parameter — good DI practice, but ensure the caller in the entry point instantiates NoteService correctly
